newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to rule on BT /MCI merger next week.
newsitem.headline: EU set to rule on BT /MCI merger next week.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to give its final ruling on the merger between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Corp of the United States on Wednesday.
"If things go as planned there will be a decision next week," a Commission official said on Wednesday, but declined to give any details.
European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert has said publicly that the merger will be cleared after the two companies agreed to make a few minor concessions.

The Commission said at the end of January, when it started a full probe into the $20-billion deal, it was worried that the two partners might be in a position to distort competition on the UK-U.S. telecommunications route. It also said it would have to assess the impact of the merger on the teleconferencing market.

The merger, announced in November, will give BT control of MCI, in which it already has a 20-percent stake. It will create the world's second largest telecoms group based on market capitalisation behind Japan's NTT Corp.
The U.S. antitrust authority must still give its green light.
